summary: AS Tallink Grupp, together with its subsidiaries, provides marine transportation services in the Baltic Sea. The company operates through Estonia-Finland Routes, Estonia-Sweden Routes, Finland-Sweden Routes, and Other segments. It offers mini-cruise, passenger transport, and ro-ro cargo services on routes between Estonia, Finland, and Sweden under the Tallink Silja Line brand. The company also operates hotels in Tallinn and Riga; Burger King franchise in the Baltics and restaurants of the fast-food chain in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania; and international travel retail business with various retail outlets on board its vessels and on shore. In addition, it operates a fleet of 11 vessels that include cruise ferries and ro-pax ferries. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Tallinn, Estonia.
